description: Idempotent entitlement grant and restore hardening. The store (Play / web checkout) is the source of truth for paid SKUs; save state is reconciled upward (union) and never stripped of prestige cosmetics. Pending grants survive process death until a checkpoint records the purchase receipt.

cloudConflict.note: Choosing an older cloud save cannot revoke a Play/web purchase; reconcile re-grants missing flags/receipts.
